digest.component_or_area: completion verification test harness (external LLM bedrock lane)
propositions: The test's observed_upsert monkeypatch stub has drifted from the real CriterionBank.upsert signature and does not accept evidence_sufficient and seeded keyword arguments that production code now passes.

When the completion verifier hits the bounded-fallback path and calls upsert with evidence_sufficient=False, the narrow test stub raises TypeError, surfaced as LLMError 'did not produce a verdict' only on the bedrock arm.
The anthropic and openai test arms avoided the TypeError by gathering sufficient evidence and never triggering the fallback path that passes evidence_sufficient.
The fix threads all keyword arguments through the test stub via **kwargs, forwarding evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future kwargs to the real upsert while preserving bookkeeping signal.
A shared, live-dependency-free helper make_observed_upsert in tests/_bank_observer.py replaces the narrow closure and enables fast unit regression coverage without live credentials.
